diagnostic_streams.scope: bounded streams of the explicitly launched controlled fixture

limits: Controlled renderer _exit(86) is process-failure recovery, not a memory-corruption test.
Retained crash pixels are offline evidence; the native generation is revoked.
Three-buffer residency is a contract bound, not observed total Chromium memory.
No libobs draw, OS sandbox acceptance or 70-second benchmark acceptance.

alpha.scope: fixture pixel arithmetic; not complete color calibration or libobs blending
fixture pixel arithmetic; not complete color calibration or libobs blending

counter.scope: visible JS counter modulo 256, not host frame index or PTS

scope: one short fixed owned native diagnostic, not full performance acceptance

static_inventory.scope: static artifact identity and local development signature

resource_measurements.cpu_unit: nanoseconds; percent 100 equals one fully occupied core
limits: Only consecutive observations of matching PID/birth/start identity contribute CPU deltas.
CPU before first/after last observation and processes shorter than the sampling interval may be missed.
Memory is a sequential sum of per-process physical footprints, not a coalition or unique physical-page total.
Reported CPU excludes the supervisor and process-list collection overhead.
Roles identify observed executable basenames; a helper role does not measure GPU utilization.
Historical cpu_percent_ps remains ps output; legacy footprint_bytes remains unspecified/null.

supervision.scope: observed owned tree; not proof against unobserved process escape or an OS sandbox
